scripts.ready: npm run build --silent && node dist/scripts/plan-scheduler.js ready
scripts.summary: npm run build --silent && node dist/scripts/plan-scheduler.js summary
scripts.serve: npm run build --silent && node dist/scripts/plan-scheduler.js serve
scripts.worker: npm run build --silent && node dist/scripts/plan-scheduler.js worker
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); fs.cpSync('prompts', 'dist/prompts', { recursive: true, force: true }); for (const f of ['dist/scripts/plan-scheduler.js', 'dist/scripts/render-plan.js']) fs.chmodSync(f, 0o755)"
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node --test --test-timeout 10000 tests/plan-scheduler.test.mjs
